title: Positive scalar cohomology injects under norm completion on punctured contractible regular-limit tests
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its norm topology, and an algebraic closure $\Omega\supset E$ with the extended norm topology. Let $I$ be a small directed poset with least element $0$, and let $(X_i)_{i\in I}$ be an inverse system of regular affine finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Require each transition $X_j\to X_i$ to be finite locally free, meaning affine and locally finite free on coordinate modules [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}(\varinjlim_i\Gamma(X_i,\mathcal O_{X_i}))$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Choose $f_0\in\Gamma(X_0,\mathcal O_{X_0})$ whose pullback $f_i$ is a nonzerodivisor for every $i$.

Let $v:V\to X$ be an affine object of the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], weakly contractible in the following sense: evaluation on $V$ sends every epimorphism of sheaves of sets on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ to a surjection. Write $f_V$ for the pullback of $f_0$, and $T=V[1/f_V]$. Let $\widehat\Omega$ be the metric completion of $\Omega$, with its extended field operations, and let $\iota:\Omega\hookrightarrow\widehat\Omega$ be the canonical isometric embedding. For $F=\Omega,\widehat\Omega$ put $C_F(P)=C(P,F)$, using all continuous maps on every profinite set $P$ [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], and $C_{F,T}=p_T^*C_F$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use internal modules and ordinary uncompleted derived categories [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Here $H^q(T,C_{F,T})$ is ordinary sheaf cohomology of the underlying abelian sheaf: the $q$th cohomology of its K-injective derived global sections [def-pur-ringed-site-zeroth-hypercohomology]. Then for every integer $q\geq1$ the actual map
$$H^q(T,C_{\Omega,T})\longrightarrow H^q(T,C_{\widehat\Omega,T})$$
induced by postcomposition with $\iota$ is injective. Empty $V,T$ are allowed. No finite-torsion acyclicity of $T$ or open-unit hypothesis is imposed, and no surjectivity, derived equivalence, completeness of $\Omega$, or finite-subextension-valued replacement of its function sheaf is asserted.
